# Core context hardening: isolation review, round 1

Branch `core-ctx` at `4d5b3ea` vs `8910034`. Reviewer: isolation-reviewer (opus), 2026-11-13. **Verdict: BLOCKED** (1 blocking, 2 follow-up). 73 targeted tests passed. Probes as `shifde_app`, rolled back.

1. BLOCKING core `core/db.py:123-137`: `Session.rollback()` with a savepoint open runs `nested.rollback(_to_root=True)` (SQLAlchemy 2.1.6 `orm/session.py:1414-1417`), firing `after_soft_rollback` for the savepoint while the root is still active: the snapshot is restored, then the root rolls back; the comment at 131-133 and B-703(1) are false. (a) `set_platform_admin(True)`; `begin_nested()`; `set_platform_admin(False)`; `s.rollback()` -> info admin=True, next transaction `app.platform_admin=on`. (b) same with the lowering failing in an aborted savepoint: fail-closed False overwritten with True. (c) `with platform_admin_context(s): sp=s.begin_nested(); <raises>`; handler `s.rollback()` and keeps using the Session -> admin on (base 8910034: False). Fix: on a savepoint rollback never store a context higher than the current one (`_lowered(current, snapshot)`), or keep the exact restore only when the root is not being rolled back in the same `_to_root` chain. Tests for (a), (b), (c) and `with s.begin_nested():` exiting by exception.
2. FOLLOW-UP core (fix with 1): tenant version: `set_tenant(A)`; savepoint; `set_tenant(B)` or `None`; `s.rollback()` leaves tenant A for later transactions; after a failed switch B-703 promises None.
3. Correct (probed): nested savepoints, outer rollback with inner open, commit after rolled-back savepoint, released savepoint then root rollback, `begin_nested` on a fresh Session, flush-subtransaction rollback, `_update` fail-closed outside savepoints; snapshots per Session; WeakKeyDictionary safe.
